title: OpenRTB 2.6 Device
description: Information pertaining to the device through which the user is interacting.

geo.description: Location of the device assumed to be the user's current location.

dnt.description: Standard Do Not Track flag as set in the header by the browser.

lmt.description: Limit Ad Tracking signal commercially endorsed.

ipv6.description: IP address closest to device as IPv6.

devicetype.description: The general type of device. Refer to AdCOM 1.0 List: Device Types.

h.description: Physical height of the screen in pixels.

w.description: Physical width of the screen in pixels.

ppi.description: Screen size as pixels per linear inch.

pxratio.description: The ratio of physical pixels to device-independent pixels.

geofetch.description: Indicates if the geolocation API will be available to JavaScript code.

flashver.description: Version of Flash supported by the browser.

mccmnc.description: Mobile carrier as the concatenated MCC-MNC code.

connectiontype.description: Network connection type. Refer to AdCOM 1.0 List: Connection Types.

ifa.description: ID sanctioned for advertiser use in the clear.

ext.description: Placeholder for exchange-specific extensions to OpenRTB.

didsha1.description: DEPRECATED. Hardware device ID (e.g., IMEI) hashed via SHA1.

didmd5.description: DEPRECATED. Hardware device ID (e.g., IMEI) hashed via MD5.

dpidsha1.description: DEPRECATED. Platform device ID (e.g., Android ID) hashed via SHA1.

dpidmd5.description: DEPRECATED. Platform device ID (e.g., Android ID) hashed via MD5.

macsha1.description: DEPRECATED. MAC address of the device hashed via SHA1.

macmd5.description: DEPRECATED. MAC address of the device hashed via MD5.
